# Prompt Pack: Desk Notes (Starter)

Who it's for: a reader paper-trading a tiny account before using real money.

Provenance: taken from live trading notes with real trades, not a story.

Disclosure: educational purposes only. Only use what you can spare.

## The prompt

Follow the written rules. Skip a setup when the tape is unclear.

### Risk rules

Exposure cap at 2% of the account. No averaging down.

## Why it works

Most skips are the edge. The cap keeps one idea from becoming the whole account.

## Metrics

Win rate, average loss, and the number of skipped setups.
